populationDefinition: The 434-post count displayed by the authenticated @urbanhermit profile on July 14, 2026. Each displayed slot is accounted for through a published mission-relevant evidence record, an aggregate-only withheld disposition, or an explicit carrier-limited unresolved disposition.

populationAudit.completenessStatement: All 434 displayed profile-count slots are dispositioned: 141 mission-relevant item records are published, 284 recovered context records are retained only as aggregate dispositions, and nine carrier-limited slots remain unresolved. The local review recovered 425 distinct public statuses. This is population reconciliation, not a platform export, deletion history, or proof that the nine records no longer exist.

exclusions: authentication, cookies, session material, and credentials
private messages, private analytics, and account-administration records
raw post text and raw browser recovery files
personal names, links, and status URLs from context-only or protected-context records
inferences that Jamie authored source statuses he reposted

contentBoundary.rationale: A public personal timeline is not blanket consent to republish or index every friendship, remembrance, location, or third-party life. Context-only and protected-context records survive in the public repository only as aggregate disposition counts; the detailed local review remains outside the repo.

metricBoundary.accountAuthoredMetrics: Mutable current visible counts are retained only for the 81 mission-relevant public account-authored evidence records.
metricBoundary.repostSourceMetrics: Source-status metrics are excluded because they belong to the source status and do not measure Jamie's repost action; the 60 public source-status evidence records use null metrics.
